activeReplacementDecision.sourceSpan: Fachanforderungen Mathematik Sekundarstufe, Schleswig-Holstein 2024, Leitidee 2: Messen, Zeile 3321
activeReplacementDecision.rationale: This source transition is the limiting transition from difference quotient to derivative, on printed p63 with intuitive limits, secant/tangent slope and numerical local-change computation in the same table block. It is not a stochastic transition process. The two atomic targets jointly distinguish conceptual instantaneous rate and numerical/graphical quotient limit; partial links do not claim each atom exhausts every table instruction.

wholeReplacementGoalContracts.descriptionEn: The learner can qualitatively describe the instantaneous rate of change as a limit case of average rates of change and locate it on the graph as tangent slope.

activeReplacementDecision.sourceSpan: Fachanforderungen Mathematik Sekundarstufe, Schleswig-Holstein 2024, Leitidee 4: Funktionaler Zusammenhang, Zeile 3530
activeReplacementDecision.rationale: This source transition changes a function graph under vertical/horizontal addition and multiplication. Printed p66 expressly lists shifts, scaling and both axis reflections in the same block. The three atomic targets describe precisely these actions; they do not establish a matrix, Markov or fixed-vector obligation, and this correction does not independently map the more demanding combined term or derivative-symmetry task.

wholeIncorrectlyMappedClusterContracts.title: Matrizen, Übergangsprozesse und lineare Modelle (Sek II)
wholeIncorrectlyMappedClusterContracts.titleEn: Matrices, Transition Processes, and Linear Models (Upper Secondary)
wholeIncorrectlyMappedClusterContracts.description: Der sichtbare Matrixkorridor der Oberstufe bündelt Matrizen als Darstellungsform, Übergangsprozesse mit Zustandsvektoren und Übergangsmatrizen, Matrixoperationen und Mehrschrittdeutung sowie späte Arbeit zu Fixvektoren und langfristigem Verhalten.
wholeIncorrectlyMappedClusterContracts.descriptionEn: The visible upper-secondary matrix corridor bundles matrices as a representational form, transition processes with state vectors and transition matrices, matrix operations and multi-step interpretation, as well as late work on fixed vectors and long-term behavior.

wholeIncorrectlyMappedClusterContracts.title: Übergangsprozesse, Zustandsvektoren und Übergangsmatrizen
wholeIncorrectlyMappedClusterContracts.titleEn: Transition Processes, State Vectors, and Transition Matrices
wholeIncorrectlyMappedClusterContracts.description: Diskrete Übergangsprozesse mit Zustands- und Übergangsgraphen beschreiben, Zustandsvektoren und Übergangsmatrizen aufstellen sowie Markov-Ketten als Modell für mehrschrittige Entwicklungen deuten.
wholeIncorrectlyMappedClusterContracts.descriptionEn: Describe discrete transition processes with state and transition graphs, set up state vectors and transition matrices, and interpret Markov chains as models for multi-step developments.

wholeIncorrectlyMappedClusterContracts.title: Matrixoperationen und Mehrschrittprozesse
wholeIncorrectlyMappedClusterContracts.description: Mit Matrizen rechnen, Matrix-Vektor- und Matrix-Matrix-Produkte deuten, einfache inverse Matrizen bestimmen und Matrixpotenzen für mehrschrittige Prozesse interpretieren.
wholeIncorrectlyMappedClusterContracts.descriptionEn: Calculate with matrices, interpret matrix-vector and matrix-matrix products, determine simple inverse matrices, and interpret matrix powers for multi-step processes.

wholeIncorrectlyMappedClusterContracts.title: Fixvektoren, stabile Zustände und Langzeitverhalten
wholeIncorrectlyMappedClusterContracts.titleEn: Fixed Vectors, Stable States, and Long-Term Behavior
wholeIncorrectlyMappedClusterContracts.description: Fixvektoren als stabile Verteilungen bestimmen und das langfristige Verhalten von Übergangsprozessen mithilfe von Matrixpotenzen und Grenzbetrachtungen untersuchen.
wholeIncorrectlyMappedClusterContracts.descriptionEn: Determine fixed vectors as stable distributions and investigate the long-term behavior of transition processes using matrix powers and limit considerations.
